entries.title: Guided Tour & Privacy Policy
notes: Added a quick interactive spotlight tour for first-time visitors
Added a Privacy Policy modal accessible from the Settings menu or /#privacy.
Made the privacy notice configurable at runtime via privacy.json or FOES_PRIVACY_* environment variables for self-hosted instances.

entries.title: Switched to VCS package, own geopacks
notes: doesnt really affect the public user
lets people import the sim library and use it for other stuff
Lets your own json geopacks be added without having to recompile or edit the source code

entries.title: Refined Simulation
notes: Added Blocs
Added per unit turnout
Added differential turnout
added other small tweaks and QOL changes

entries.title: Added UK Elections, added Mobile Layout and decluttered UI
notes: Added UK elections support
Added mobile layout for map
Fixed couple of UI issues (states carrying over on scenario switch)
Fixed Scenario Editor carrying over changes to another scenario
Fixed Forecast changes carrying over to Live Elections
Made a lot of small QOL changes

entries.title: Map Screenshots
notes: Added a map screenshot tool with a live preview, Copy Image and download function.
The screenshots adapt automatically to the active theme, Electoral College bar, or Parliament hemicycle.

entries.title: UI & Simulation Polish
notes: Fixed the Closest Races panel overlapping the top-right controls in Forecast mode.
Replaced the placeholder in the top-left HUD with the FOES hemicycle logo.
Fixed the GitHub repository link in the bottom-right pill.
Added Docker image publishing for self-hosting.

entries.title: Initial release
notes: Initial public release of FOES.
